description: End-to-end service assurance workflow for Network-as-a-Service (NaaS), including intent definition, monitoring session lifecycle, policy management, incident handling, and remediation.

assurance_session_id.description: Identifier for a service assurance monitoring session

intent_id.description: Identifier for a service intent being assured

service_id.description: Identifier for a provisioned NaaS service (e.g., virtual circuit, VPN, slice)

remediation_plan_id.description: Identifier for an automated remediation plan

topology_snapshot_id.description: Identifier for a captured network topology snapshot used in assurance analysis

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: define_assurance_intent
functions.description: Create or update a service assurance intent that specifies SLOs and KPIs for a NaaS service or group of services.

intent_id.description: Existing intent_id to update; omit or null to create a new intent

name.description: Human-readable name for the assurance intent

description.description: Detailed description of the assurance objective

scope.description: Defines what this intent applies to

service_ids.description: List of service_ids when scope_type is single_service or service_group

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier when scope_type is tenant

slice_id.description: Identifier for the network slice when scope_type is network_slice

traffic_selectors.description: Optional traffic selectors to narrow the assurance scope

slos.description: Service level objectives to be enforced and monitored

upper_bound.description: Optional upper bound when direction is range

violation_policy.description: Defines how violations for this SLO are treated

breach_threshold_percentage.description: Percentage of samples within window that must violate to trigger

sustained_duration.description: ISO 8601 duration the violation must persist before triggering

auto_incident.description: Whether to auto-create an incident on violation

kpis.description: Additional KPIs to observe but not necessarily enforce

enabled.description: Whether this intent is currently active

tags.description: Free-form key-value metadata for the intent

functions.returns: Intent ID and full intent configuration, including derived metadata.

functions.name: check_service_assurance_eligibility
functions.description: Validate that selected services, slices, and scopes support the requested assurance features before starting monitoring.

intent_id.description: Identifier of the previously defined assurance intent

service_ids.description: Optional override list of service_ids to validate; when omitted, uses intent scope

capability_requirements.description: Capabilities required for the planned assurance session

topology_snapshot.description: Optional topology constraints to validate against

forbidden_nodes.description: Nodes that must not be in the path

functions.returns: Eligibility report per service_id, including supported capabilities, limitations, and reasons for any ineligibility.

functions.name: start_assurance_session
functions.description: Start a new service assurance monitoring session based on an intent and capability requirements.

intent_id.description: Identifier of the assurance intent to activate

session_name.description: Human-readable name for the assurance session

interval_seconds.description: Sampling interval in seconds for continuous mode

scheduled_windows.description: Applicable when mode is scheduled; list of time windows

retention.description: Data retention policy for session metrics and traces

export_targets.description: External systems to which data should be exported

probe_config.description: Configuration for active probes and synthetic tests

notifications.description: Notification preferences tied to this session

target.description: Email address, Slack channel, webhook URL, etc.

tags.description: Custom labels for the assurance session

functions.returns: Assurance session ID, initial status, and resolved monitoring topology, including bound service_ids.

functions.name: get_assurance_session_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status, health, and high-level metrics of an assurance session.

include.description: Optional additional sections to include in the response

time_window.description: Optional time window for metrics and violations

relative.description: Alternative to from/to: ISO 8601 duration such as PT15M, PT1H

functions.returns: Session lifecycle state, health status, key aggregates, and optionally per-service state, violations, and associated incidents.

functions.name: update_assurance_session
functions.description: Modify an existing assurance session configuration, such as monitoring profile, probes, or notifications.

assurance_session_id.description: Identifier of the assurance session to update

updates.description: Fields to update; omitted fields remain unchanged

pause.description: If true, temporarily pause monitoring without terminating the session

functions.returns: Updated assurance session configuration and new effective status.

functions.name: stop_assurance_session
functions.description: Gracefully or forcefully stop an active assurance session.

assurance_session_id.description: Identifier of the assurance session to stop

mode.description: How the session should be stopped

preserve_data.description: Whether collected data should remain accessible after stop

archive_export.description: Optional export configuration for session archive

path.description: URI or path where the archive should be stored

reason.description: Reason for stopping, for audit and incident linking

functions.returns: Stop confirmation, final status, and optional archive location.

functions.name: list_assurance_policies
functions.description: List and filter assurance policies that can be attached to intents and sessions.
functions.returns: Paginated list of assurance policies, including metadata and attachment information.

functions.name: attach_assurance_policy
functions.description: Attach an assurance policy to an existing intent or session to extend detection and response behavior.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy to attach

target_id.description: ID of the intent or session to which the policy is attached

functions.returns: Attachment confirmation including effective policy configuration and link to affected intents/sessions.

functions.name: get_assurance_violations
functions.description: Query SLO and policy violations detected in the context of an assurance session or intent.

assurance_session_id.description: Filter violations for a specific assurance session

intent_id.description: Alternative filter for an intent across sessions

relative.description: Alternative to from/to: ISO 8601 duration such as PT30M

include_incident_link.description: Whether to include associated incident IDs

functions.returns: Paginated list of violations including SLO, metrics, severity, status, and optionally related incidents.

functions.name: create_assurance_incident
functions.description: Manually or automatically create an incident based on one or more violations, with impact and context.

violations.description: List of violation descriptors that triggered the incident

description.description: Detailed narrative of the issue and suspected impact

functions.returns: Incident ID, created timestamp, and normalized incident record with links to violations and sessions.

functions.name: update_assurance_incident
functions.description: Update status, ownership, and remediation details of an assurance incident.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the incident to update

reason.description: Reason or note for change, stored in audit log

functions.returns: Updated incident record with new status, ownership, and timeline entries.

functions.name: plan_remediation_actions
functions.description: Generate or validate a remediation plan for an incident or set of violations, including rollback strategy.

incident_id.description: Primary incident for which remediation is planned

assurance_session_id.description: Context assurance session for telemetry-based validation

template_id.description: Remediation template to use when strategy is template_based

requested_actions.description: Explicitly requested actions when strategy is custom

parameters.description: Action-specific parameters (e.g., new bandwidth, path preference)

simulate_only.description: If true, only simulate impact without applying changes

functions.returns: Remediation plan ID, ordered list of actions, risk assessment, and rollback strategy.

functions.name: execute_remediation_plan
functions.description: Apply, monitor, or roll back a remediation plan generated for an incident, with retry semantics for failed steps.

remediation_plan_id.description: Identifier of the remediation plan to execute or control

stop_on_error.description: If true, halt execution on first error

step_overrides.description: Optional parameter overrides for specific steps

functions.returns: Execution status per step, overall success/failure, and any rollback results when applicable.

functions.name: naas_assurance_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import naas assurance entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: naas_assurance_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many naas assurance entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: naas_assurance_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many naas assurance entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: naas_assurance_bulk_export
functions.description: Export naas assurance entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: naas_assurance_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across naas assurance entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: naas_assurance_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for naas assurance events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: naas_assurance_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for naas assurance notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: naas_assurance_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more naas assurance entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: naas_assurance_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to naas assurance on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: naas_assurance_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a naas assurance operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: naas_assurance_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending naas assurance change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: naas_assurance_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending naas assurance approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: naas_assurance_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a naas assurance entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: naas_assurance_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a naas assurance entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: naas_assurance_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a naas assurance entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: naas_assurance_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a naas assurance entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: naas_assurance_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for naas assurance activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: naas_assurance_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a naas assurance view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: naas_assurance_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to naas assurance entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: naas_assurance_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given naas assurance payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: naas_assurance_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a naas assurance entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: naas_assurance_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a naas assurance entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
